text: Thank you everyone. This is Dina Griffiths, and I'm going to call to order the Select Committee of the School Board for Hearing Appeals today, September 22nd, 2026. And with that, I'd like to make a motion to convene into a closed meeting. I move that the Loudoun County School Board recess this public meeting and enter a closed meeting pursuant to 2.2-3712 of the Code of Virginia for the

following purpose: Discussion or consideration of matters that would involve disclosure of information contained in a scholastic record concerning a student, namely, a parent request for an LCPS student to attend a school outside of their assigned attendance zone, which is authorized by 2.2-3711.82 of the Code of Virginia. Thank you, Ms. Dunnam. All those in favor say aye. Aye.

I move to the following resolution certifying the closed meeting by adopted and reflected in the minutes of the public meeting. Resolution number 09-26/27. Whereas the Loudoun County School Board has convened a closed meeting on this date pursuant to an affirmative recorded vote in accordance with the provisions of the Virginia Freedom of Information Act, and whereas 2.2-3712D

of the Code of Virginia requires a certification of the school board that such a closed meeting was conducted in conformity with Virginia law. Now therefore, be it resolved that the Loudoun County School Board hereby certifies that to the best of each member's knowledge, only public business matters lawfully exempted from open meeting requirements by Virginia law were discussed in the closed meeting to which this certification applies, and only such business matters
